_comment_top: R6 Pillar 6b / D-C-05 / task 054 — seed row for the SendWorkspaceArtifactHandler chat tool. Surfaces a single LLM-visible 'send_workspace_artifact(widgetType, title, widgetData, matterId?)' function that dispatches a finished agent artifact to the user's workspace pane as a new tab via IWorkspaceStateService.UpsertTabAsync.
_comment_routing: Runtime invocation routes to the C# class via sprk_handlerclass = 'SendWorkspaceArtifactHandler' (= nameof handler class). Auto-discovered via ToolFrameworkExtensions.AddToolHandlersFromAssembly (ADR-010) — ZERO new top-level DI line.
_comment_placement_boundary: ADR-013 binding: the handler injects IWorkspaceStateService directly (BFF-internal workspace plumbing) — NOT through a PublicContracts facade. This mirrors task 053's SprkChatAgentFactory.ResolveTools system-prompt block which also reads IWorkspaceStateService directly from the per-turn scope. Workspace state is a chat-session state primitive owned by Pillar 6a, not an AI capability — facade indirection would add no boundary value.
_comment_security: sprk_requiredcapability = null (intentional). Sending an artifact to the workspace pane is a default user affordance — every chat session, standalone or playbook-bound, can dispatch artifacts. The 4-variant widgetType enum (Summary | DocumentViewer | Dashboard | Table) is the authorization surface — there is no 'free text widget' escape hatch, so the LLM cannot smuggle arbitrary payloads into the workspace outside the closed union.
_comment_tenant_isolation: ADR-014 binding: the chat session's TenantId is forwarded into the tab's TenantId + the underlying Redis key + Cosmos partition key. Cross-tenant dispatch is structurally impossible — WorkspaceStateService.UpsertTabAsync enforces a tenant match between the arg tenantId and the WorkspaceTab.TenantId, throwing InvalidOperationException on mismatch (caught by the handler + surfaced as ValidationFailed).
_comment_adr015: ADR-015 data governance: telemetry logs handler name + decision GUID + tabId GUID + widgetType discriminator + matter scope present/absent + title LENGTH + duration ONLY. NEVER the LLM-supplied widgetData body content; NEVER the title text; NEVER the user's chat message. The tab's SourceProvenance.CreatedBy is the deterministic 'agent:{chatSessionId}' sentinel — never user message text.
_comment_description_loadbearing: sprk_description is LOAD-BEARING per NFR-12: the LLM uses the description text to decide WHEN to invoke this tool. G-P3 UAT round-2 R2-D (2026-07-07): the description now leads with the 'Workspace' layout-tab variant (the ONLY variant the post-046 client materializes live, via the workspace_open_tab SSE frame → PaneEventBus workspace.widget_load bridge) and marks the four legacy artifact variants as not-visible in the current workspace UI — the model must never claim a visible tab from them. G-P3 UAT round-4 R4-2 (2026-07-07): added the Compose document PRE-SEED contract — optional widgetData.documentId (sprk_document GUID) resolves server-side (user-OBO) to its SPE drive-item pointer and rides the widgetData as a 'compose' seed the SpaarkeAi host threads into ComposeLaunchContext; session-uploaded chat files carry NO SPE pointer (extracted text only) and can never pre-seed — the description says so and the handler opens the tab EMPTY with an honest note.
_comment_consumption: Read by scripts/Seed-TypedHandlers.ps1. Idempotent — script queries by sprk_handlerclass + sprk_toolcode with sprk_name 'SYS-%' filter; UPSERTs.
sprk_description: Open a tab in the user's workspace pane. PREFERRED USE — open a named workspace LAYOUT as a live tab: widgetType 'Workspace' with widgetData {"kind":"Workspace","layoutName":"<layout name>"}. Use layoutName 'Compose' when the user asks to open the Compose editor or to start composing/drafting a document in the workspace; other layouts (e.g. 'Daily Briefing', 'Documents') open the same way. When opening the Compose layout ABOUT A SPECIFIC DOCUMENT, add widgetData.documentId (the sprk_document GUID, e.g. from a search result path tables/sprk_document/records/{guid}) — Compose then opens WITH that document loaded. Session-UPLOADED chat files cannot pre-seed Compose (they exist only as extracted text, not stored documents) — omit documentId for them; the tab opens empty and the tool result says so — relay it honestly. If the requested layout does not exist, the tool result lists the available layout names — relay them honestly. The tab opens immediately in the workspace pane and the tool result confirms it; only claim a tab was opened when this tool result says so. Legacy artifact variants (Summary, DocumentViewer, Dashboard, Table) record an artifact to workspace state but are NOT visible in the current workspace UI — avoid them unless explicitly instructed. Agent-created tabs default to visible-to-assistant.
_comment_availableincontexts: 100000001 = Chat only. Workspace tab dispatch is a chat-surface affordance — playbook nodes write to sprk_analysisoutput + sprk_workingdocument, not the chat-session per-tenant workspace tab list. Future R7+ work MAY extend this to Both (100000002) if cross-context artifact dispatch becomes a coherent flow.

sprk_jsonschema.title: SendWorkspaceArtifactHandler Request
sprk_jsonschema.description: Argument shape for chat-driven invocation of the send_workspace_artifact tool. widgetType 'Workspace' opens a named workspace layout as a live tab (emits the workspace_open_tab SSE frame the client materializes); the legacy artifact variants persist a WorkspaceTab via IWorkspaceStateService.UpsertTabAsync.

widgetType.description: Closed enum selecting the workspace tab variant. 'Workspace' (preferred) opens a named workspace layout as a live tab. The 'widgetData.kind' field MUST equal this value.

title.description: Display title for the workspace tab — shown on the tab strip and in tooltips. For 'Workspace', use the layout name (e.g. 'Compose'). NEVER raw user message text — author a concise headline.

documentId.description: Optional (Workspace variant only): sprk_document GUID to pre-seed the Compose layout with — Compose opens WITH that document loaded. MUST be a real sprk_document row id (e.g. from tables/sprk_document/records/{guid} citation paths); session-uploaded chat file ids are NOT valid here (they carry no stored file) — omit for them.

widgetData.description: Per-variant payload. Workspace requires {layoutName} (the layout's display name, e.g. 'Compose') or {layoutId} (GUID); optional {documentId} (sprk_document GUID) pre-seeds the Compose layout with that document. Legacy variants: Summary requires {body, tldr?}; DocumentViewer requires {documentId, filename, mimeType, sizeBytes, hasSelection?, selectionText?}; Dashboard requires {layoutId, dashboardName, lastViewedSection?}; Table requires {rowCount, filteredColumns[], selectedRows[], sortColumn?, sortDirection?, dataSourceId?}. Deterministic identifiers + display metadata only — ADR-015 binding: NEVER raw user message text.

matterId.description: Optional Dataverse sprk_matter GUID to anchor the tab to (legacy artifact variants only). When omitted, the chat session's MatterId is used; when neither is present the tab is anchored to a synthetic 'unattached' context (Guid.Empty) that the user can later pin to a real matter via the workspace UI.

matterName.description: Optional display name for the matter — shown in the tab tooltip when matterId is supplied. When omitted the GUID is used as the display name.

sprk_configuration._comment: No method-discriminator dispatch — this row exposes a single LLM-facing function. Empty object reserved for future per-row defaults (e.g., default widget-type override, per-tenant 'always-pin' policy).
sprk_configuration._comment_riskprofile: Confirmation Policy v2 (FR-A1-03, task 032) catalog-declared risk factors — DATA extending sprk_sideeffectclass per policy-v2-origin-classification-decision-tree.md §1. Opening a workspace tab is a private, fully-reversible UI affordance (the user can close it) with no system-of-record mutation ⇒ Tier 2a (private/internal reversible; ✅ card + Undo when explicit+complete). Consumed by GateRiskProfile.FromConfiguration + RiskTierResolver; NEVER a runtime model judgment.
